results.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 lets AI voices change emotion mid-sentence - Notebookcheck News
results.content:
Instead of relying on basic voice presets, users can insert instructions directly into their scripts. A character might begin speaking calmly, become increasingly frustrated, and finish a sentence in a whisper, all without switching between separate recordings. Even synthetic actors now have to take direction.

Drama 3 also supports multi-character conversations and 83 languages. Instructions can be applied to individual words or passages, allowing creators to emphasize specific expressions without changing the rest of the script.
